about: Template-slot labels that turn Loghub's Linux sample (2,000 real syslog lines from sshd/PAM, su, login, ftpd, klogind and the kernel; Loghub commit dd61d09) into a gold standard, under the same rule as loghub_slots.json: a HOST slot whose value is a valid IP address is IP_ADDRESS (hostnames are not gold); every USER slot value and every account name written literally into a template is USERNAME; everything else is not gold. Templates not listed here have no gold slots. Drafted after the log-username tier was committed (c699ec6) and before any system was scored on these lines.
drafted_by: AI assistant (Claude), from the template text only
